matchMedia.absent: Disables control with (Unsupported) indicator, preserving functional manual choices

clipboard.present: Direct one-click copy to system clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText
clipboard.absent: Opens accessible export drawer containing CSS tokens and explicit manual copy instructions

cssModernFeatures.colorMix: CSS @supports not (color: color-mix(...)) provides opaque/rgba solid fallbacks
cssModernFeatures.backdropFilter: CSS @supports not (backdrop-filter: ...) provides solid surface fallbacks
